sql.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT las.company_title FROM logistics_aistore AS las WHERE las.company_title NOT IN (SELECT las2.company_title FROM logistics_aistore AS las2 WHERE (las2.state ILIKE $1))

sql.SQL: SELECT las.storage_type_title, COUNT(las.code) AS las_code_count FROM logistics_aistore AS las WHERE (las.state ILIKE $1) GROUP BY las.storage_type_title HAVING COUNT(las.code) > $2 ORDER BY las_code_count DESC
